where: Results > Taxonomic account > Leptobrachella yongshunensis Huang, Wu, Jiang & Zhang, sp. nov. > Description of holotype (one long sentence, clauses separated by semicolons; no Class, Order or Family heading printed); quote cut inside the sentence
quote: (Figs 5, 6, Table 2) Adult male, body size medium (SVL 28.9 mm); … eye diameter (ED 3.5 mm) slightly shorter than snout length (SL 3.7 mm); …
note: new trait: eye_diameter_mm (same key as main). The sentence is the first of the holotype description; the page reader inserts tooltip expansions after SVL, ED and SL that are not printed text and are left out. Table 2 holotype column ED (eye diameter) reads 3.5, the same value. Table 2 also prints population rows (male n = 3 2.7 ~ 3.5 (3.1 ± 0.40); female n = 3 3.1 ~ 3.7 (3.5 ± 0.33); subadult n = 5 2 ~ 3.2 (2.5 ± 0.49)) whose column assignment to species was garbled by the reader, so they are not filed. Not a repeat: grep of docs/ for the species and DOI finds pupil_shape (d630) and sensory_anatomy (d574) rows, no ED value in mm. Amphibian Species of the World page opened from my own search (Anura/Megophryidae/Leptobrachiinae/Leptobrachella): 'Leptobrachella yongshunensis Huang, Wu, Jiang, and Zhang, 2025' ... 'Zoosyst. Evol., 101: 110'; 'Holotype: JSUHJ2024005, by original designation.'; Comment: comparative morphology, advertisement call and 16S mtDNA in the original publication, sister taxon of L. wulingensis; no synonymy, split or redelimitation.
